errors.text: The requested critical threshold is not identified as 900 K; the hypothesis instead leaves T_crit undetermined and vaguely suggests a regime above 600 K.
The central target mediator—stable dislocation density at 300–600 K followed by a substantial reduction and rapid lattice disorder at 900–1200 K—is not reconstructed.

The proposed dominance of thermally activated screw-dislocation glide and decreasing stacking-fault energy is not supported for this FeNiCrCoCu coating and conflicts with evidence E4, which associates elevated temperature with increasing intrinsic stacking-fault energy.
Evidence from BCC MoNbTaW at up to 2000 K is transferred to an FCC FeNiCrCoCu coating without adequate justification.
